sentences.text: It depends on whether the Rs 500 per month is being levied as penal interest; for a UCB, penal interest is not permitted, and the document instead says a UCB may charge interest on unpaid interest at the contracted rate of interest, and not at the penal rate of interest.
The documents do not state that a Rs 500 per month penal charge is itself penal interest.

The Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023) says penalties for non-compliance shall be treated as “penal charges” and shall not be levied in the form of “penal interest,” but that document is superseded on 2026-11-23.

missing.slot: whether the Rs 500 per month charge is penal interest or penal charges
